verdict.rationale: Zero is an AI email client, so headless or CI automation is a fair axis, but the pack documents no headless mode, CLI, or CI usage of the product itself. The MCP server tools belong to a separate MCP-server story. Its auth also requires copying a browser session cookie, with OAuth only 'coming soon', which does not show unattended CI use. The pnpm dev, test and eval scripts are contributor tooling, not a product automation capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
